jobs.description:

We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting . Our focus is to connect clients with high-quality solutions , talent and ambitious opportunities worldwide.   
As a part of The Brandtech Group
, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions
enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results.
Role:
Integrated Project Manager
Location: 
Remote (Bogotá)
Language:
Proficiency in English is required as we are a global business
About the role

Are you looking for an opportunity to innovate with brands? Involving the development of strategy, creative concepts, content and campaign implementation? This role will be underpinned by passion and ambition, and those with experience in leading digital content and social campaigns within a creative agency will have an advantage.Project manager position with a professional who demonstrates strong project ownership, proactive communication, effective planning, and consistent execution to support the team’s delivery requirements.

What you will be doing:

End-to-end project management: Independently manage projects from briefing and planning through production, approvals, and final asset delivery, ensuring all deliverables meet agreed timelines and requirements.
Timeline and priority management: Build and maintain project schedules, manage competing priorities, anticipate potential delays, and proactively address risks and dependencies.
Cross-functional coordination: Effectively coordinate Account Management, Creative, Production, and other relevant stakeholders to ensure alignment and smooth project execution
Proactive problem-solving: Identify potential issues early, propose actionable solutions, and escalate risks with clear recommendations when leadership involvement is required
Project tracking and reporting: Maintain accurate project documentation, trackers, status reports, and action items, ensuring consistent visibility into project progress and outstanding deliverables.
Quality and delivery accountability: Ensure deliverables comply with agreed specifications and quality standards, with appropriate follow-up and quality control throughout the production process.
Stakeholder communication: Communicate clearly and proactively, manage expectations, follow through on commitments, and maintain accountability for project outcomes.
Adaptability and prioritization: Effectively manage changing requirements, last-minute requests, and multiple concurrent projects while maintaining organization and delivery standards.

Expected Outcomes

Consistent execution against agreed project timelines.
Visibility into project status, risks, and dependencies.
Strong ownership of deliverables and stakeholder follow-ups
Identification and resolution of operational issues.
Autonomy in day-to-day project management.
Reliable delivery quality and adherence to production requirements

What you need to be great in this role:

3+ years of relevant project management experience, preferably within an advertising agency or creative production studio.
Demonstrated ability to manage projects independently with limited day-to-day supervision.
Strong organizational, planning, prioritization, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities.
Experience managing high-volume asset production, multiple deliverables, and complex approval processes.
Ability to anticipate risks, take ownership of challenges, and drive projects toward resolution.
Experience working with international brands, global stakeholders, or regional teams is preferred. Professional
English proficiency and familiarity with project management tools and workflows

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure
for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role:

As a Project Manager, you will be expected to leverage deep cross-functional expertise to coordinate with enterprise customers globally, guiding integrations from conception to launch by aligning technical teams, managing timelines, mitigating risks, and ensuring all deliverables meet strategic objectives in the following ways:

Own end-to-end project management for enterprise launches using our brokerage APIs (equities, crypto, options, and more)
Collaborate with external stakeholders (product, engineering, compliance teams, etc.) to scope, plan, and execute integration timelines
Work cross-functionally with internal teams (BD, engineering, legal, compliance, operations and customer success) to resolve issues and align on resources
Facilitate weekly partner check-ins, drive action items, and ensure progress toward key deliverables
Track and report on project status, risks, and dependencies to internal leadership and partner stakeholders
Help partners navigate onboarding requirements, such as KYC, AML and regulatory disclosures
Document processes and continuously improve onboarding frameworks to scale future partner integrations

Internally, the Project Manager is a key person to give the best context of a partner to many teams, including leadership. Simply put, the Project Manager is the voice of the customer internally at Alpaca.

As a project manager in a highly collaborative role, the ideal candidate must demonstrate a strong communication, troubleshooting, solutioning and proactiveness skillset.

Key Responsibilities:

Be the face of Alpaca to some of the largest enterprise businesses in their respective regions
Provide updates to Alpaca’s leadership team, being transparent with successes, blockers and solutions
Stay updated on internal product development timelines, and work closely with the technical teams to roll out new features to partners
Establish yourself as a subject matter expert on Alpaca’s API and collaborate with fintechs around the world
Ensure feature requests by partners are communicated to the technical teams and are adequately prioritized
Support the success team with advice on integration items, including new products
Solutionize for partners targeting key regions Alpaca is focusing on, driving the company's mission to open financial services to everyone on the planet
Create internal and external resources that can be leveraged by both partners and internal teams

Must-Haves:

2+ years of enterprise-level business project management experience with strong process, analysis, design, and documentation skills
Strong verbal and written communication skills in English, to drive clarity on goals, set expectations, and collect feedback
Demonstrated problem-solving ability and attention to detail to deliver high-quality output while meeting deadlines.
Flexibility to work with customers around the world
Familiarity and interest in FinTech, financial markets, and investing applications
Experience with communication and project management tools such as Slack, JIRA, Confluence, Basecamp and Google Workspace
Startup mindset
Sales and customer success background, leading the customer experience
Training/enablement experience
Brokerage/stocks experience
Crypto experience

Technical background, including:

Familiarity with Metabase
Experience with modern APIs (REST, Websockets, Server Sent Events)
Experience with enterprise software implementations
Technical troubleshooting skills
Experience with issue management (JIRA) and API logging tool
Familiarity with Postman and curl requests

How We Take Care of You:

Competitive Salary & Stock Options
Health Benefits
New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500
Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager II
jobs.description:
About Torus

Torus is headquartered in Utah and is expanding manufacturing at our 545,000-square-foot facility in Salt Lake City called GigaOne. We are

the world’s first mesh energy infrastructure, uniting communities through resilient, sustainable, and intelligent power.

We design, engineer, manufacture, install, and support our systems end-to-end, standing behind them throughout their lifecycle. Torus systems help reduce costs, lower emissions, and protect facilities from outages, while strengthening the security and reliability of the broader utility grid. Torus is committed to American manufacturing, engineering excellence, and building energy systems that last.

Torus has raised over $267 million from investors like Magnetar, Mercado, ICONIQ and Origin Ventures. The investments are helping to accelerate deployment of modular power plants across utilities, data centers, and industrial sectors. This investor confidence reflects the strength of our team, technology as well as the scale of the problem we are solving.

At Torus, you will be part of something larger than a single product or technology. Your work will help build energy infrastructure that supports and strengthens our electrical grid, critical systems, industry, and communities for decades to come. We value accountability, collaboration, and clear thinking. We are looking for people who want to solve hard problems and build things that matter.

About The Role

The Technical Project Manager II

will own the schedule, scope, and coordination of Torus site builds, from design freeze through procurement, construction, commissioning, and handoff to operations. Our sites are built from repeatable units and scale to hundreds of nodes, so the work is as much about sequencing vendors, lead times, and dependencies as it is about any single task.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is technical enough to understand what a delayed optic, an unconfirmed carrier handoff, or an unbalanced PDU branch does to a go-live date, and is organized enough to keep many parallel workstreams moving. You will work daily with network, compute, and systems engineers, facilities and electrical contractors, carriers, and equipment vendors, and you will be the person who knows what is blocked, why, and what happens next.

Who You Are

You work comfortably between technical depth and cross-functional pace, whether you’re in a design review, a change-window call, or a vendor escalation.

You see the whole system. You know how a delayed optics shipment or a firmware hold ripples into site turn-up, security review, and handoff to operations, and you use data to plan around it.
You lead with the answer. You turn complex technical discussions into a clear answer, an owner, and a deadline. Your status updates, runbooks, and stand-ups keep people aligned without adding process.
You earn trust across teams. Network, compute, systems, security, and facilities engineers know you’ll ask about their constraints before asking them to move faster.
You hold speed and quality together. You push for urgency and still insist on testing, validation, and rollback plans before anything goes into production.
You let the customer break the tie. Your customers are the sites, operators, and internal teams who depend on your uptime. When trade-offs get hard, you make the call with them in mind and help the team do the same.
You stay steady in ambiguity. Fast scale-up means incomplete information. You define a path forward anyway, share progress and setbacks directly, and meet blockers and incidents with realism and confidence in the team.

Responsibilities

Program planning and delivery

Own the integrated plan for each site build: scope, milestones, dependencies, critical path, and go-live criteria
Break each site into repeatable workstreams (network core, compute, power, cooling, fiber and cabling, security, telemetry) and track them against the plan
Run weekly cross-functional status meetings, maintain a single source of truth for schedule and risks, and produce clear status reports for leadership
Identify schedule risks early, propose mitigations, and escalate decisions that need an owner
Maintain a repeatable build playbook so that each new Pod or System is faster than the last

Procurement and supply chain

Work with engineering and procurement to turn designs into bills of materials, review vendor quotes for completeness (optics, cabling, licenses, support), and track open quote gaps to closure
Track orders, lead times, shipments, and receiving across multiple vendors, and flag long-lead items (switches, firewalls, optics, power and cooling equipment) at the start of each build
Coordinate RMAs, substitutions, and re-quotes without losing the schedule
Maintain an accurate inventory and delivery status for each site, including what is owned, ordered, and still missing

Site, power, and facilities coordination

Coordinate electrical, mechanical, and cooling work with facilities teams and contractors, including power feeds, PDUs, cooling distribution, and rack and cabinet readiness
Schedule and run change windows, power-on events, and cutovers, with rollback plans and clear communication
Track site readiness gates before equipment ships and before nodes are powered on
Manage on-site logistics for installation crews and technicians, including access, safety requirements, and sequencing

Carriers, ISPs, and external vendors

Manage circuit orders and turn-up with carriers, including demarc and handoff details, optics, BGP and IP-space requests, and install dates
Track address-space and registry applications that have long lead times
Manage vendor and contractor statements of work, deliverables, and acceptance
Be the single point of contact for external parties on schedule and dependencies

Commissioning and handoff

Define and track commissioning and acceptance criteria with engineering for each site
Drive punch lists to closure and confirm that documentation, runbooks, labeling, and as-built records are delivered before handoff
Coordinate the handoff of nodes and sites to operations and to customers or hosting partners, including credential, access, and onboarding checklists

Risk, change, and communication

Maintain a risk and issue register for each site, ranked by impact on availability and schedule
Apply change control to scope, schedule, and design changes, and communicate downstream impacts to cost, schedule, and other sites
Track budget against plan for each build and flag variances early
Document lessons learned after each build and feed them back into the playbook

Required Experience

5+ years of project management work
3-5 years of experience managing technical projects in data center, network, infrastructure, or construction environments
Demonstrated experience delivering projects with multiple vendors, long-lead procurement, and fixed go-live dates
Working technical fluency in networking and compute fundamentals (switches, firewalls, servers, optics and cabling, power and cooling) sufficient to challenge estimates and understand dependencies
Experience building and maintaining project plans, risk registers, and status reporting using standard tools (for example, Jira, Smartsheet, MS Project, or similar)
Experience reviewing vendor quotes, bills of materials, and statements of work
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work with engineers, executives, and external vendors
Ability to prioritize across many concurrent workstreams and make clear decisions with incomplete information
Comfort with change control and checklist-driven procedures
Willingness to travel within Utah, with occasional travel to remote sites

Preferred Experience

Experience on GPU or high-density compute deployments, or data center build-outs
Familiarity with liquid cooling, high-density power distribution, or colocation and facility coordination
Experience managing carrier circuit turn-ups and ISP or IP-address requests
Familiarity with OT/ICS or energy infrastructure environments
Experience with infrastructure automation or a technical background in systems or network engineering
Experience with budget tracking and cost reporting on capital projects
Project management certification (PMP, PRINCE2, or similar)
Experience with Jira or similar tools, including building dashboards from live data

Additional Details

Background Check:

All candidates are subject to a background check.

Location:

This role is a hybrid remote position based in Salt Lake City. The Technical Project Manager will be expected to travel to Torus locations in Utah, with occasional travel to remote sites.

Compensation:

$140,000 - 175,000 (Note: We have the flexibility to hire at different levels, which may impact the corresponding pay range.)

Work Authorization:

Applicants must already have the legal authorization to work in the US without requiring any employer sponsorship.

Physical Requirements

Constantly operates a computer and other peripheral office equipment such as a printer or mouse.
Ability to communicate information so others can understand. Must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations.
Must report to work reliably and with the ability to use full and unimpaired skills and judgment to safely execute your job.
Proficiency in reading, writing, and speaking English required.
When on the production floor, ability to observe, detect and respond to audible and visual machine malfunction warnings.
Ability to traverse uneven terrain during site surveys at construction and industrial sites, at times for extended periods.
Ability to ascend stairs and ladders and navigate active construction areas.
Ability to wear required PPE at job sites and on the production floor, such as a hard hat/safety helmet, safety glasses, ear protection, high-visibility apparel, and protective footwear.
Ability to lift up to 25 lbs occasionally.
Ability to work outdoors in varying weather.
Ability to work outside normal business hours for power-on events and cutovers.
Ability to travel to Torus sites in Utah and occasionally to remote sites.

Our Perks & Benefits

Benefits eligibility is based on employment status.

Financial

Employee Rewards Package including equity
401(k) Retirement Savings Plan
Torus paid life and AD&D Insurance with options to purchase additional coverage
Voluntary short- and long-term disability insurance

Health & Wellness

Health Benefits Package: Choice between traditional PPO or HSA-eligible medical plans with Torus covering 50% of medical premiums; Dental insurance; and Vision insurance
Plan participants have access to telehealth services, mental health support and coaching, and exclusive discounts on brands, dining, entertainment, and more.

Time Off

Unlimited discretionary PTO
10 paid company holidays
Waiting period-free 100% paid parental leave

Culture & Community

Regular company-wide offsites to showcase our progress and learnings. A time to step back, think strategically, and work on the business together.
Team members receive Torus branded gear
Peer Recognition Program
Fully stocked break rooms with free snacks and drinks. Because great work deserves great fuel.

jobs.description:
Compensation:
$105,000 - $120,000

Reports to:
Director of VBC Operations

Direct Reports:

Remote (with the ability for limited travel to facility partners and team meetings)

About Vitae Health Systems:

Founded in 2018, Vitae Health Systems is one of the largest providers of behavioral health, internal medicine, and podiatry services to residents of Skilled Nursing and Assisted Living Facilities. Headquartered in Chicago, IL, we currently operate in over 10 states and are rapidly expanding throughout the USA.

Overview

Vitae launches its ACO under the CMS Long-term Enhanced ACO Design (LEAD) Model on January 1, 2027, building on our experience in ACO REACH High Needs. The VBC Program Manager builds and runs the operating rhythm of the LEAD ACO, making sure the work that drives results (beneficiary alignment, utilization, quality performance, and program compliance) is tracked, scheduled, and followed through on time.

This is a hands-on operating role. You will lead the VBC operations team, run the weekly and monthly performance cadence with the VBC data resource, and work with the VBC clinical team and operations managers to turn performance data into clear, prioritized actions. You own the calendar, the cadence, and the follow-through. Clinical standards and compliance decisions remain with clinical and compliance leadership.

Key Responsibilities

LEAD ACO Operating Cadence and Performance Tracking

Run the weekly team huddle and monthly performance review covering alignment, utilization, quality, and reported spend, using KPIs and targets set by VBC leadership
Track performance against the LEAD quality measures and Prevention and Quality Plan milestones, and report variances to leadership
Monitor utilization drivers (admissions, readmissions, ED visits, post-acute stays) and confirm high-risk patients have a named owner and documented action, escalating gaps to clinical leadership
Review operational CMS reports and data feeds monthly, flag variances early, and escalate risks with a recommended path
Maintain the master calendar of CMS deadlines and deliverables, with a named owner for each, and follow up so nothing is missed

Alignment and Compliance Oversight

Oversee the voluntary alignment program against leadership-set targets and deadlines, including a documented pre-submission review before each CMS submission
Oversee reconciliation of CMS alignment lists to census and EHR data, and lead root cause reviews on avoidable attrition (deaths, hospice elections, moves, Medicare Advantage enrollment)
Reconcile Participant and Preferred Provider lists to HR and credentialing records at the TIN/NPI level, escalating any change that needs a leadership or Compliance decision
Verify that beneficiary notifications and outreach activities are completed, tracked, and documented to CMS requirements, in partnership with Compliance

Cross-Functional Partnership

Work with operations managers on how VBC activities are scheduled and delivered at the facility and NP level, surfacing barriers early and avoiding unnecessary burden
Partner with VBC clinical leadership so workflows, checklists, and handoffs reflect clinical standards
Support development of provider-facing materials (scorecards, tip sheets, trainings) with the clinical and data owners, coordinating timelines and operational input

Data, Reporting & Continuous Improvement

Submit and sequence reporting requests to the VBC data resource through a single intake, review data for reasonableness before use in reviews, and flag manual work that could be automated
Prepare the performance summaries the Director of VBC Operations presents to senior leadership and ACO governance, aggregating data, clinical, and operational input
Lead root cause reviews when measures move off target and turn findings into action plans with named owners and due dates, tracking each to closure and routing clinical actions to clinical leadership
Facilitate a quarterly improvement cycle (plan, do, study, act) based on financial and performance results, with the Director of VBC Operations as sponsor: convene Finance, clinical, and data partners to select opportunities, assign actions, evaluate results, and document learning in a VBC operating playbook

Team Leadership

Lead the VBC operations team and serve as its first point of contact: coach, set priorities and escalation thresholds, build SOPs with process owners, and resolve operational questions and blockers within defined boundaries, escalating strategic, financial, compliance, and policy matters to the Director of VBC Operations
Provide input to the Director of VBC Operations on structure and staffing as scope grows

What Success Looks Like

First 90 days: The master CMS calendar is in place with named owners. The weekly and monthly cadence is running and escalation thresholds are defined. The first quarterly improvement cycle is launched, with opportunities, owners, measures, and evaluation dates set. Team members have clear goals and documented workflows
First year: Two or more improvement cycles are completed with documented results and feed a VBC operating playbook. Alignment, quality, and utilization are tracked against targets all year, with action plans when a measure is off target. Escalations arrive with context and a recommended path

Requirements

Required

Bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, public health, business, nursing, or a related field
4+ years in value-based care, ACO operations, or population health (provider-side strongly preferred)
Direct experience in a CMS ACO model (ACO REACH, especially High Needs, MSSP, or LEAD)
Experience in post-acute, SNF, or long-term care
2+ years managing staff
Track record running recurring operating cadences and hitting deadlines
Experience running structured improvement cycles (e.g., PDSA, Lean) and building playbooks
Working knowledge of CMS alignment (claims-based and voluntary), ACO quality measures, beneficiary protections and marketing requirements, and benchmark and settlement basics
Ability to drive follow-through across clinical, operational, and data teams without direct authority
Clear communicator who can explain data to clinicians and leaders, and is comfortable with financial and utilization reports, Excel, BI dashboards, and EHR data

Preferred

Understanding of NP-led care teams
Clinical background (e.g., RN)
Master's degree

About the Opportunity
Our client, an established and growing multidisciplinary engineering consulting firm in the Greater Toronto Area, is seeking a Mechanical Engineer (Project Manager II)

In this role, you will oversee mechanical building services projects from planning through design, construction administration, and completion. Working closely with senior management, project managers, project coordinators, design professionals, and site inspectors, you'll be responsible for coordinating project teams, managing schedules and budgets, maintaining client relationships, and ensuring successful project delivery.

Beyond day-to-day project management, you'll have the opportunity to mentor junior team members, improve project management processes, and collaborate with business development teams on new opportunities. This position offers direct exposure to senior leadership and the opportunity to take on greater responsibility within a growing engineering consulting environment.

If you're ready to build on your mechanical engineering experience, lead multidisciplinary project teams, and expand your influence across technical delivery and client relationships, this could be an excellent next step in your career.

Why Consider This Opportunity?
Our client offers a supportive, collaborative environment with a strong focus on professional development, employee well-being, and work-life balance.

Highlights include:

Competitive Compensation:
Salary increases based on individual performance.

Performance Bonuses:
Additional earning potential tied to performance.

Employer-sponsored social activities and trips, including opportunities to travel.

Key Responsibilities

Project Management & Delivery

Manage mechanical building services projects from planning and design coordination through construction administration and completion.

Work collaboratively with project managers, project coordinators, engineers, designers, and other technical professionals to deliver successful project outcomes.

Develop, maintain, and monitor project schedules, task assignments, resource requirements, estimated hours, and key milestones.

Organize and chair internal project meetings and client meetings to discuss progress, resolve issues, and maintain alignment.

Respond to client inquiries regarding project scope, technical requirements, schedules, budgets, and financial matters.

Take ownership of project execution while balancing technical requirements, client expectations, and business objectives.

Apply knowledge of mechanical building services to support the effective delivery of HVAC, plumbing, and fire protection projects.

Oversee and coordinate mechanical design deliverables to ensure technical accuracy, completeness, and alignment with project requirements.

Coordinate site inspections and work with site inspectors to ensure required project activities are completed effectively.

Facilitate communication between project management, design teams, and site inspectors to resolve technical questions and maintain project coordination.

Delegate construction administration responsibilities, including shop drawing reviews, contract document preparation, and related project documentation.

Monitor construction administration activities to ensure deliverables are completed accurately, on time, and within assigned budgets.

Coordinate project documentation and construction-related activities throughout the project lifecycle.

Ensure project deliverables align with applicable building codes, relevant industry standards, and client requirements.

Team Leadership & Process Improvement

Mentor and support project coordinators, junior project managers, and other team members.

Provide guidance on project management practices, technical coordination, client communication, and project delivery.

Delegate responsibilities effectively, monitor progress, and help team members prioritize tasks and meet deadlines.

Foster a collaborative environment where team members work toward shared project goals.

Identify opportunities to improve project management procedures, internal workflows, and operational efficiency.

Strengthen coordination between project management, design, and construction administration teams.

Promote accountability, quality control, and consistent project delivery practices.

Take initiative in resolving challenges and supporting the broader objectives of the engineering team.

Client Relations & Business Development

Build and maintain strong working relationships with clients, consultants, contractors, and internal stakeholders.

Communicate project updates, technical considerations, schedules, and financial matters clearly and professionally.

Work with business development and proposal teams to prepare responses to client requests and support new project opportunities.

Contribute to proposals, project planning, and related business development activities as required.

Support client satisfaction by ensuring expectations are managed and project commitments are met.

Collaborate with senior management to support business objectives and the continued growth of the mechanical engineering practice.

Requirements

Qualifications & Experience
The ideal candidate will bring a combination of mechanical building services expertise, project management experience, and proven leadership capabilities.

Required and preferred qualifications include:

A minimum of 5–7 years of direct experience in mechanical building services
.

A diploma or degree in mechanical engineering, mechanical building services, or a related technical program.

A Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) designation in Ontario is preferred
.

Experience managing mechanical building services projects from design through construction administration and completion.

Experience with mechanical building retrofits, renovations, and equipment replacements is considered an asset.

Strong working knowledge of HVAC, plumbing, and fire protection systems.

Good understanding of construction project management principles, including budgeting, scheduling, resource allocation, and project coordination.

Knowledge of the National Building Code of Canada and the Ontario Building Code.

Familiarity with relevant ASHRAE and CSA/ULC standards.

Experience coordinating design teams, site inspectors, contractors, and other project stakeholders.

Demonstrated leadership and mentoring skills, with the ability to delegate responsibilities and support team development.

Strong client relationship management and problem-solving abilities.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical and financial project matters clearly.

Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities in a fast-paced consulting environment.

Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.

A proactive, detail-oriented approach to project management and technical quality.

The ability to work collaboratively while taking ownership of project outcomes.

Who Will Thrive in This Role?
You'll be well suited to this opportunity if you are someone who:

Enjoys leading mechanical building services projects and coordinating teams toward shared goals.

Can balance technical knowledge with project budgets, schedules, resource planning, and client expectations.

Takes ownership of project delivery and proactively addresses challenges before they affect outcomes.

Is comfortable delegating tasks, setting priorities, and supporting the development of junior team members.

Communicates effectively with clients, consultants, contractors, and multidisciplinary project teams.

Enjoys improving processes and finding practical ways to increase project efficiency.

Can manage competing deadlines without compromising quality or attention to detail.

Is interested in contributing to proposals, client relationships, and business growth.

Values collaboration, accountability, and continuous professional development.

Is looking for an opportunity to work closely with senior management and continue progressing toward greater leadership responsibility.

Benefits

Interview Process
The recruitment process is designed to give both the candidate and the organization an opportunity to assess technical expertise, project management capabilities, leadership style, and long-term fit.

A preliminary conversation by phone or email to discuss your professional background, career interests, and the opportunity.

Virtual Technical Interview:
A 45–60-minute discussion with an engineering manager covering your mechanical building services experience, project management background, technical knowledge, and professional development goals.

In-Person Interview:
A 60-minute meeting with the engineering manager and company president to discuss the position, team, company growth plans, and your potential contribution.

References & Background Check:
Reference checks and background screening are completed as part of the offer process.

Offer & Onboarding:
Successful candidates will receive an employment offer and begin the onboarding process.

Interested in Learning More?
If you're an experienced mechanical building services professional looking to lead projects, mentor developing talent, strengthen client relationships, and take the next step in your project management career, we'd welcome the opportunity to connect.

Apply today
to learn more about this opportunity and explore whether it's the right next step in your career.

jobs.title: Sales Project Manager
jobs.description:
As a member of the Global Business Operations team, you will focus on the end-to-end execution, customized scoping, and cross-functional alignment required to move complex hardware projects from early-stage sales to full mass production. You will act as a critical bridge between pre-sales opportunities and operational delivery, eliminating friction across custom engineering, production, and customer onboarding. This is a full-time position designed to ensure high-value industrial computing solutions are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned for maximum profitability.

The Global Business Operations team is a collaborative group dedicated to delivering an outstanding customer experience through high-quality and high-velocity execution. It is the engine that accelerates OnLogic's growth, balancing technical value with measurable financial results.

We believe in the power of in-person collaboration and the benefits of a strong workplace community. Therefore, this role requires an onsite presence at either our South Burlington, VT or Cary, NC office. We encourage candidates who are able to relocate or comfortably commute to apply.

In this role, you'll be responsible for:

Collaborate with Sales & Sales Engineering during the presales phase to assess system configuration, project feasibility, estimate timelines, and identify potential risks.
Lead the drafting of detailed Statements of Work (SOWs), ensuring clear project definitions, deliverables, milestones, and SLAs (Service Level Agreements).
Manage the internal process to align project deliverables with operational capacity.
Serve as the operational point of contact for customers from Presales to Mass Production.
Secure approvals for project scope, goals, and deliverables in collaboration with senior management and stakeholders.
Develop full-scale project plans, action item list, tracking milestones and dependencies via project management tools (e.g., Jira, Smarsheet).
Facilitate seamless cross-functional communication between Sales, Product Management, Engineering, Technical Project Management, Legal, Supply Chain, and Production teams.
Lead weekly project status meetings, capturing action items, and driving accountability across departments.
Manage resource allocation, ensuring cross-functional teams are aligned with project timeline and customer expectations.
Proactively manage changes in project scope, identify potential bottlenecks, and devise contingency plans.
Monitor project budgets, tracking billable hours and resource utilization to protect profit margins.
Communicate any changes to the customer's project regarding timeline, budget, and scope to ensure an excellent customer experience.

The team you will be joining:

Our Sales & Marketing team is a collaborative crew of digital marketers, creative storytellers, revenue drivers, and account strategists dedicated to positioning OnLogic as the first choice in edge computing and helping customers make the impossible possible. Together, they build demand, fuel growth, and champion the customer experience across every touchpoint. From creative campaign development and ecommerce management to strategic account growth, complex solution selling, and partner co-sell motions, this team bridges brand awareness with high-impact revenue generation and scalable sales operations.

Learn more about Life at OnLogic: www.onlogic.com/life-at-onlogic

Requirements

5+ years of project management experience delivering complex, custom hardware projects, ideally within the industrial, rugged, or edge AI sector.
Proven operational background in Sales, Business Operations, or cross-functional delivery environments.
Hands-on expertise with key systems, including CRMs (Salesforce or HubSpot), ERP platforms (Odoo preferred), and modern project management tools like Jira and Smartsheet.
Exceptional executive-level communication and negotiation skills, with a track record of presenting to C-suite leadership and navigating technical customer escalations.
Proactive approach to risk management, timeline execution, and cross-departmental accountability with a strong sense of individual ownership.
PMP or comparable project management certification preferred, along with a Bachelor's degree.
Ability to work in the U.S. without visa sponsorship, now or in the future.

Who we're looking for:

You are driven to deliver exceptional customer satisfaction by turning complex hardware requests into seamless operational wins.
You hold internal teams accountable to project milestones, budgets, and SLAs to drive cross-functional productivity.
You adapt fluidly to shifting priorities while maintaining strict attention to detail and rigorous quality standards across every custom deliverable.
You partner closely with Sales and Engineering to strategically solve technical challenges and make high-value solutions possible.
You proactively identify process improvements to eliminate operational bottlenecks, shorten time-to-market, and optimize project margins.

Who we are:

OnLogic employees have the opportunity to shape our future and drive impactful change. We design and manufacture specialized edge computing solutions for companies all over the world, helping them to make the seemingly impossible possible. Our computers are designed to work where others fail, and it's our vision to be the first choice in edge computing. To make that vision a reality, we've built a team of ambitious problem solvers, guided by the company's core values of Open, Fair, Innovative, and Independent. We have an open office, open salaries, and strive to be fair and transparent in our decision making. We encourage input and feedback from every member of our team and look to improve ourselves and our business every single day.

Diversity is an essential element of our core values. Not just respecting, but actively embracing a variety of backgrounds, life experiences, and opinions, helps us foster innovation, enhances our problem-solving capabilities, and promotes learning and engagement among the members of our team. We strongly encourage those with diverse backgrounds to apply.

We are committed to providing a safe, inclusive, and harassment-free workplace for all employees. We do not tolerate any form of harassment, discrimination, or bias based on race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, religion, disability, age, or any other protected characteristic.

To learn more about our values, our mission and what it's like to work at OnLogic, visit www.onlogic.com/careers.

Benefits

The salary range for this role is $90,000 to $110,000. We determine final compensation based on discussions with applicants and their experience in similar roles.

A comprehensive Benefits package
401k Plan with 3% Employer Contribution

A personal development plan created to help you (and us) grow

We’re recruiting a Digital Project Manager to join a successful, privately owned Nottingham business with more than 30 years of established growth and an impressive international client base.

This is an opportunity to build a genuine long-term career within an organisation that combines the stability and personal culture of an established independent business with the scale and variety of working internationally.

Elevate your career at Airbus Belfast as our Business Operations Manager.
You will be the lead designer of our growth strategy, building a robust value stream through lean methodology and data-driven financial management. By bridging the gap between shop-floor operations and corporate support, you will ensure our facility remains a global benchmark for rate-readiness. We are looking for an influential leader to de-risk our supply chain and accelerate commercial success in a world-class aerospace hub.

Strategic Integration & Risk Mitigation: You are the bridge between operations and support functions. You use the ARM (Active Risk Management) tool and TIP (Tactical Implementation Plans) to identify financial and operational bottlenecks, ensuring change management plans are executed to eradicate "hard-hitting" business problems.
Operational SQCDP Performance: You hold accountability for the Business Management System. By monitoring trends in Safety, Quality, Cost, Delivery, and People (SQCDP), you drive rate-readiness planning to ensure the airframe value stream can meet future build demands and increased production rates.
Financial & Resource Stewardship: You manage significant growth by exercising delegated budget authority over CAPEX, NRC (Non-Recurring Costs), NPO, and Indirect Payroll. You ensure the business is "resourced for the future" by aligning recruitment and training with long-term Airbus profitability goals

Continuous Improvement:
Experience operating business management systems across SQCDP (Safety, Cost, Quality, Delivery, People) areas.

Financial planning skills for growth; ability to manage budget authority (NPO, NRC, CAPEX, Indirect Payroll).

Communication:
Ability to listen, adapt style to various audiences, share information openly, and resolve conflict.

Leadership & Influence:
Ability to inspire, motivate, and influence teams/stakeholders outside direct span of control.

Customer Focus:
Strategy development focused on adding value and exceeding customer expectations.

Results Orientation:
Driving performance through stretched, competitive targets

Desirable Skills

Leadership Experience:
Time spent within the organization as a leader.

Cross-Functional Integration: Demonstrated experience resolving issues across Engineering, Supply Chain, and support functions.

Risk & Tactical Planning:
Hands-on experience with risk mitigation tools (e.g., ARM) and formulation of Tactical Implementation Plans (TIP).

Workforce & Rate Readiness
Planning: Ability to conduct rate readiness planning to meet future build demands, along with recruiting and developing personnel.

jobs.description:
Want to make a positive difference to the future of people and our one shared home, the Earth? Working at WWF could be your opportunity of a lifetime.

All around the world, people are waking up to the devastating impacts of climate change and nature loss. The situation today is worse than the darkest predictions of just ten years ago, pushing billions of people to the edge and threatening lives and livelihoods. At WWF, we are facing our biggest crisis – and our biggest ever opportunity – to create a better future for people and nature. With over 60 years of experience and an active presence in more than 100 countries, we work to achieve both on-the-ground and global policy action, from protecting and restoring species and their habitats, to transforming markets and policies toward sustainability.

Our people come from hugely diverse backgrounds and with a variety of expertise, ranging from conservation science and advocacy to HR and finance. We welcome applications from anyone who believes they can help us tackle this enormous global challenge and drive the urgent conservation impact needed to restore our planet.

What We Do

We are an independent conservation organization, striving to sustain the natural world for the benefit of people and the ecosystem. From individuals and communities to businesses and governments, we are part of a growing global movement calling for bolder action on climate and nature, demanding that world leaders set nature on the path to recovery by 2030. WWF works to address the most dominant drivers of nature loss through system-wide changes in how food and energy are produced and consumed, and in how financial systems are structured. By implementing change in every country, we aim to drive visible and positive impacts on the ground, helping to restore nature in the most critical places around the world, from the Amazon to the Coral Triangle.

Engaging everyone means addressing the barriers to participation faced by some groups in society, including local communities. Conservation will only be sustainable if it is owned by, and benefits, local people. That’s why Indigenous Peoples and local communities must be at the centre of action on climate and nature. WWF is committed to using its resources and global network to support these communities in creating together the most effective solutions where they live.

Humanity is still in time, we have a clear pathway to solve this crisis. At WWF, we call on everyone to join the global movement, change how we live, and take action now.

WWF International global recruitment team are exclusively managing this vacancy. We kindly ask that you do not contact the local office on this position.

As Senior Project Manager – Hazina Implementation, you hold day-to-day delivery accountability for Project Hazina, a strategic initiative to implement a unified, cloud-based Global Finance & Accounting System (GFAS) on Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations. The goal of the project is to replace an ageing, fragmented finance systems landscape across more than 30 entities, including the Secretariat and its managed Country Offices. The project will be delivered over approximately two years.

You are accountable for delivering the project within the scope, schedule, budget and quality set by the project governance.

MISSION OF THE DEPARTMENT

To align and harmonise technology, digital and data capabilities across the WWF Network to enable conservation impact at scale while safeguarding the organisation and the people we work with, through fit for purpose solutions that are device and hardware agnostic, mobile functional, built on integrated, secure and scalable cloud enabled technology platforms and are consistently delivered and supported anytime anywhere.

Major Functions

Own end-to-end delivery of the Hazina implementation: build and maintain the master plan covering scope, schedule, budget, resourcing, dependencies and stage gates from contract signature through discovery, design, build, test, rollout, stabilisation and decommissioning of legacy systems.
Manage the implementation partner and the wider vendor estate: hold the implementation partner to contracted scope, deliverables, quality and commercials; run change control; and escalate commercial or performance issues through Procurement, Legal and the Executive Sponsor.
Own the project risk profile: identify, quantify and actively mitigate delivery risk — data migration, integration, scope creep, resource availability, adoption and legacy-platform continuity — and give governance bodies an honest view of confidence against milestones.
Steward the investment: manage the approved budget, track spend and forecast against variance, protect the contingency, and report cost position and benefit realisation to the Business Owner, SPOC, the other relevant governance bodies.
Lead business change and adoption: direct the change, communications, training and readiness effort across the Secretariat and Country Offices so that standardised finance processes are understood, accepted and used from go-live, and so that benefits are realised rather than assumed.
Safeguard quality and operational readiness: define acceptance criteria, own the testing and UAT regime, and confirm with Finance, GTDS and Cybersecurity that each release meets architecture, security, control and supportability standards before it is recommended for go-live.

Major Duties And Responsibilities

Project planning and delivery management

Develop, own and maintain the integrated Hazina delivery plan — scope, schedule, budget, resources, dependencies, assumptions and stage gates — covering discovery, design, build, configuration, data migration, integration, testing, training, rollout, stabilisation and legacy decommissioning.
Establish the programme team and operating rhythm: define roles, responsibilities and the delivery RACI across WWF and the implementation partner so that accountability for the plan, the budget and the go-live recommendation is unambiguous and the "who owns this" gaps do not arise.
Track progress against milestones and critical path, maintain the RAG position for the Systems Projects Oversight Committee reporting cycle, and proactively drive recovery actions as soon as slippage appears rather than reporting it after the fact.
Operate formal change control over scope, schedule and cost, ensuring every material change is assessed for benefit, risk and funding impact and approved at the right level of governance.

Stakeholder management and governance

Working with the Executive Sponsor and the Business Owner to ensure project governance is appropriately designed, implemented and fully functioning throughout the project lifecycle.
Prepare and present delivery reporting, decision papers and stage-gate submissions for the Systems Projects Oversight Committee, the Executive Team, and other relevant governance bodies for oversight of implementation.
Work with the Executive Sponsor, the Business Owner for Finance, and the GTDS leadership to align competing priorities, resolve escalations, and secure the decisions required to keep the project on track.
Build and hold the confidence of Country Directors, Finance Directors and Country Office focal points where adoption is influenced rather than instructed, and where local finance practice, capacity and connectivity vary widely.
Manage expectations candidly: set out trade-offs between scope, time, cost and quality with the evidence behind them, and hold a defensible position under challenge from senior stakeholders and committee members.

Budget and investment management

Manage the approved Hazina budget end to end: maintain the cost baseline, phase spend across FY27 to FY29, forecast to completion, explain variance and flag overrun risk before it compounds.
Identify and agree with GTDS Platforms and Finance the recurring costs after go-live — licences, environments, hosting, vendor support and integration services — so that they are budgeted and owned before the project closes.
Control the contingency deliberately, with a documented basis for every drawdown, and identify value-engineering and cost-avoidance opportunities with the implementation partner and Microsoft.
Own the benefits realisation plan: baseline the measures behind the assessed non-financial benefits, track them through and beyond go-live, and report realisation honestly to SPOC, the Executive Team and the other governance bodies.

Risk, issue and dependency management

Own the project risk and issue registers, with named owners, mitigations, triggers and target dates; actively manage the exposures that decide project outcomes — data migration and data quality, integration dependencies, scope creep, resource availability, partner performance, user adoption and business continuity.
Maintain the continuity position for the legacy finance systems through decommissioning, so that the organisation is never exposed to an unsupported platform and a partially delivered replacement at the same time, and agree with Finance, Internal Audit and GTDS how historical finance data is archived, retained and kept accessible for audit and reporting after each legacy system is switched off.
Escalate material architecture, data, cybersecurity, data protection, finance policy or compliance matters to the accountable authority — the GTDS Enterprise Solutions and Solution Architecture lead, the Director, Data, AI and Platforms, the Global CISO, the Director of Technology and Digital Services, or Finance leadership — rather than absorbing them within the project.
Ensure the project’s control environment, audit trail and documentation are sufficient for internal and external audit scrutiny at any point in delivery.

Resource, team and vendor management

Resource and mobilise the WWF side of the project: secure workstream leads, business process owners, subject matter experts and Country Office participation, and keep them available against competing operational demands.
Lead a multi-disciplinary, multi-location team without line authority — setting direction, resolving conflict, coaching, and sustaining pace and morale across a two-year delivery in multiple time zones, languages and operating contexts.
Manage the implementation partner day to day: agree and monitor the statement of work, deliverable acceptance, resource profile and rate card; challenge estimates and designs; and hold the partner to schedule, quality and knowledge-transfer commitments.
Work with Procurement and Legal on contract variations, service credits and commercial negotiation, and provide the evidence base for any escalation with the vendor.

Solution quality, data and operational readiness

Work within GTDS technical design authority: solution architecture, integration design and GTDS technology standards are set and approved by the GTDS Enterprise Solutions and Solution Architecture lead. The Senior Project Manager plans and runs delivery against them and escalates any conflict between schedule, cost and standards.
Drive the design and configuration agenda towards a standardised global core in line with the design principles: challenge customisation requests, protect the out-of-the-box position that the business case rests on, and ensure exceptions are justified, costed and approved.
Own the data migration plan with Finance and the Data, AI and Platforms team — scope, cleansing, mapping, reconciliation, dress rehearsals and sign-off criteria — and treat data readiness as a gating condition for go-live, not a parallel activity.
Ensure master data definitions, record identifiers and the system of record for each shared data area — including grants and awards, projects, offices and implementing entities, and budgets and expenditures — are agreed with GTDS data architecture and the Finance data owners, so that Hazina stays consistent with connected systems such as PI360, the grants management system.

Thank you for considering a career at Ensemble!

Ensemble is a leading provider of technology-enabled revenue cycle management solutions for health systems, including hospitals and affiliated physician groups. They offer end-to-end revenue cycle solutions as well as a comprehensive suite of point solutions to clients across the country.

Ensemble keeps communities healthy by keeping hospitals healthy. We recognize that healthcare requires a human touch, and we believe that every touch should be meaningful. This is why our people are the most important part of who we are. By empowering them to challenge the status quo, we know they will be the difference!

O.N.E Purpose:

Customer Obsession: Consistently provide exceptional experiences for our clients, patients, and colleagues by understanding their needs and exceeding their expectations.
Embracing New Ideas: Continuously innovate by embracing emerging technology and fostering a culture of creativity and experimentation.
Striving for Excellence: Execute at a high level by demonstrating our “Best in KLAS” Ensemble Difference Principles and consistently delivering outstanding results.

The Opportunity:

CAREER OPPORTUNITY OFFERING:

Bonus Incentives
Paid Certifications
Tuition Reimbursement
Comprehensive Benefits
Career Advancement
This position pays between $101,600- $152,400 based on experience

By embodying our core purpose of customer obsession, new ideas, and driving innovation, and delivering excellence, you will help ensure that every touchpoint is meaningful and contributes to our mission of redefining the possible in healthcare.

The Senior Business Intelligence Analyst turns complex financial and operational data into trusted, decision-ready insight for finance leaders and business partners. Working primarily in Power BI and Databricks, this role designs semantic models, builds executive dashboards and develops the curated data pipelines that feed them. The analyst partners closely with finance, operations and data engineering teams to define metrics, improve data quality, and scale self-service analytics across the organization.

Key responsibilities:

Design, build and maintain Power BI reports, dashboards and semantic models that support revenue cycle, financial planning, performance management, and executive reporting.
Develop well-structured Star schema data models and advanced DAX measures, applying industry best practices for performance, row-level security and reusability.
Build and optimize data transformations in Databricks using SQL and PySpark, delivering curated analytics-ready tables in the Lakehouse (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog).
Translate business questions from revenue cycle, finance and operational stakeholders into clear requirements, KPI definitions, and analytical solutions.
Establish data validation and reconciliation checks to ensure accuracy and consistency of reported figures.
Manage Power BI workspaces, deployment pipelines, refresh schedules, and comply with Ensemble Health Partners governance standards.
Mentor junior analysts, lead peer reviews and promote BI standards, documentation and self-service adoption and support Power BI report office hours.

Required qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems or related fields.
5+ years of experience in business intelligence, data analytics, revenue cycle, or financial analytics.
3-5 years of advanced Power BI expertise, including semantic data modeling, DAX, M, Power Query and Power BI Service administration.
Hands-on experience with Databricks, including SQL, notebooks and Delta Lake; working knowledge of PySpark or Python.
Strong SQL skills and expertise in dimensional (Star schema) and Third Normal Form (3NF) modeling, relational databases, data warehousing concepts.
Ability to communicate complex findings clearly to executive and non-technical audiences.

Preferred qualifications:

Experience in healthcare revenue cycle management or finance and FP&A environment heavily preferred.
Familiarity with Unity Catalog, Databricks Genie, Azure data services, Microsoft Fabric or Git-based CI/CD.
Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300) or Databricks certification.
Must be inquisitive and demonstrate openness to innovation including AI to explore better processes and ways to alleviate friction and improve patient and client experiences.
This is a remote position; however, candidates must be willing and able to travel to and work onsite at client, temporary, or corporate office locations as business needs require.

Join An Award-winning Company

Five-time winner of “Best in KLAS” 2020-2022, 2024-2025

Black Book Research's Top Revenue Cycle Management Outsourcing Solution 2021-2024

22 Healthcare Financial Management Association (HFMA) MAP Awards for High Performance in Revenue Cycle 2019-2024

Leader in Everest Group's RCM Operations PEAK Matrix Assessment 2024

Fortune Media Best Workplaces in Healthcare 2024

Great Place to Work certified 2023-2024

Innovation

Purpose + Values

Bottom line, we believe in empowering people and giving them the tools and resources needed to thrive. A few of those include:

Associate Benefits – We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the physical, emotional, and financial health of you and your family, including healthcare, time off, retirement, and well-being programs.
Our Culture – Ensemble is a place where associates can do their best work and be their best selves. We put people first, last and always. Our culture is rooted in collaboration, growth, and innovation.
Growth – We invest in your professional development. Each associate will earn a professional certification relevant to their field and can obtain tuition reimbursement.
Recognition – We offer quarterly and annual incentive programs for all employees who go beyond and keep raising the bar for themselves and the company.

Ensemble is an equal employment opportunity employer. It is our policy not to discriminate against any applicant or employee based on race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, religion, national origin, age, disability, military or veteran status, genetic information or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. Ensemble also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

Due to business, operational, payroll, and regulatory requirements, this position is limited to individuals who reside and are authorized to work within the United States. Applications generated from outside the United States will not be considered. Individuals may reapply when located within the United States.

Ensemble provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act and applicable state and local law. If you require accommodation in the application process, please contact TA@ensemblehp.com.

jobs.title: Business Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
At Xceleration, we design employee recognition and reward programs that truly connect people to their work. Our RewardStation® platform is used worldwide for everything from peer-to-peer recognition to service milestones, allowing companies to create experiences that reflect their values and reward employees in meaningful ways. We’re proud to work across more than 90 countries, delivering solutions that adapt to different cultures and work environments. Joining Xceleration means working with cutting-edge technology while being part of a team that values input and collaboration. Our environment is designed to help you grow, contribute, and see your efforts directly impact how companies engage and motivate their employees. If you’re looking for a space where your ideas can shape the future of workplace recognition, Xceleration is the place.

The Business Intelligence Analyst will own the analytics layer behind our client recognition and incentive programs on RewardStation. This role will model program data, build and maintain the dashboards clients and account teams run on, and use AI tooling as a core part of how you work — to move faster on SQL, QA, documentation, and insight, while staying accountable for what the numbers say. This is a hands-on build role, not a reporting-request queue.
What you'll do
Model the data.
Design and maintain data models and semantic layers (star schemas, metric definitions) that make program data reliable and reusable across reports. Build the pipelines.
Build, version, and document SQL transformations; implement automated data-quality checks and own fixes when something breaks. Ship the dashboards.
Develop and maintain client-facing and internal dashboards in our BI platform; standardize KPIs for participation, engagement, redemption, and program ROI. Work AI-first.
Use LLM tools and AI-connected data agents to draft and review SQL, generate first-pass analyses and narrative summaries, and automate recurring reporting. Validate every AI output before it reaches a client. Deliver insight.
Investigate client and program questions, surface trends, and turn findings into clear recommendations for account, product, and leadership teams. Modernize the stack.
Contribute to our BI platform migration and modernization: migrate reports, retire legacy artifacts, and improve performance. Keep it governed.
Maintain the data dictionary and metric documentation; handle client data in line with privacy and security requirements.
What you bring
Proactive ownership.
You find the question before it's asked, turn a vague business need into a spec and a shipped result, and drive the work to done. Clear written and verbal communication with non-technical stakeholders is a given. We're hiring a builder, not an order-taker.3–5 years in business intelligence, analytics engineering, or data analysis, ideally in a SaaS or B2B platform environment.Advanced SQL (T-SQL required; columnar engines such as DuckDB or Snowflake a plus) and solid data-modeling fundamentals.Production experience in at least one modern BI tool — Sisense, Power BI, Tableau, or Looker — including semantic-layer design.Working Python for analysis and automation (pandas or similar) and comfort with Git-based workflows.Daily, hands-on use of AI assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar) in analytics work, with the judgment to catch when they're wrong.
Nice to have
dbt or similar transformation frameworks; ELT patterns on cloud storage (S3) or a cloud warehouse.DuckDB / MotherDuck, and exposure to MCP-based or agentic data tooling.SSIS or legacy ETL experience, useful for migration work.Jira / Confluence; experience in employee recognition, incentives, or HR tech.
Tools you'll use
Claude, DuckDB / MotherDuck, Python, Git, MCP-connected data tools, Jira / Confluence, SQL Server.
How we measure success
Dashboards and models are trusted: metric definitions are documented and defect rates fall quarter over quarter.Turnaround on client and internal data questions shrinks as AI-assisted workflows and reusable models take hold.Migration milestones are delivered on schedule with no loss of client-facing 
How we work

We are a small team. We directly communicate with one another, no layers to route around. Decisions get made in the room. We’re aggressive about AI leverage — not as a talking point, but because a team this size can’t ship what we’re shipping otherwise. We’re a team of bright, driven professionals, each of whom brings unique perspectives, experience, ideas, and skills to our roles. Our company culture means everything to us – we call it CARE (Collaborative. Adaptable. Respectful. Efficient.) Every member of our team works hard to exemplify these qualities in every aspect of the work we do each day.

Xceleration is an Equal Opportunity Employer and we do not discriminate on the basis of actual or perceived race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex (which includes pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding and medical conditions related to pregnancy, childbirth or breastfeeding), gender, gender identity, and gender expression, religious creed, disability (mental and physical) including HIV and AIDS, medical condition (cancer and genetic characteristics), genetic information, age, marital status, sexual orientation, military and veteran status, denial of family and medical care leave, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law.

jobs.title: Business Data Analyst I
jobs.description:
The Business Data Analyst I role follows a hybrid schedule, with three days per week in the office and two days working from home. The position also requires 10-15% local travel to other sites.

The Business Data Analyst I role has a national salary range of $70,000 - $115,000.

For roles within California the range is $70,304 - $115,000 and Washington is $80,169 - $115,000.

DHL Supply Chain offers multiple benefits including Medical, Dental, Vision, Prescription, Discounted Stock Purchase, and a generous PTO policy.

Are you ready to turn data into decisions that drive real impact in the supply chain world? At DHL Supply Chain, we’re looking for a Business Data Analyst I who thrives on solving complex problems, creating powerful visualizations, and delivering actionable insights. This is your chance to be at the heart of operations, influencing strategy and performance in a dynamic warehouse environment. If you're passionate about analytics, innovation, and making a difference, this role is for you. If you're a curious, self-driven problem solver with a passion for analytics, innovation, and impact—this role is for you!

Job Description

As a Business Data Analyst I, you will play a key role in transforming operational data into strategic insights that identify opportunities, improve performance, and reduce costs. You’ll collaborate with site leadership and key stakeholders to build reports, implement standard tools, and support data-driven decision-making. This role is ideal for someone with foundational analytics experience who is ready to take ownership of projects and grow into a trusted resource for data solutions.

Develop and maintain Power BI reports to support operational and strategic decisions
Full development of Power BI including data visualization and back-end data model design
Clean, model, and analyze data using SQL, DAX, and statistical techniques to uncover trends and drive improvements
Collaborate with site and sector leadership to identify opportunities for efficiency and cost reduction
Assist various functional teams (HR, Finance, etc.) with customized analytical solutions to meet evolving business needs
Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights through presentations and reports for internal and customer use
Ability to leverage data from various systems that support our operations (Warehouse Management System, Timekeeping systems, etc.)
Manage analytics projects independently, from concept to delivery
Serve as a point of contact for Power BI-related questions and support

Required Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Logistics, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field, or 4 years of equivalent professional experience, required
1+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related field, required
Hands-on experience using SQL or other scripting languages (such as Python or R) to query, clean, and transform data, required
Proficiency in Power BI, including building dashboards and reports from scratch, required
Experience writing DAX expressions to automate and enhance Power BI reports, required
Strong understanding of statistical concepts and data modeling techniques, preferred
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights, preferred
Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and meet deadlines, required
Must be able to work fully onsite if role based out of a warehouse, required

Our Organization is an equal opportunity employer.

Description

A world where every child is safe, every family is strong, and hope outshines hardship. We help children heal from trauma so they can build healthy relationships, succeed in education and discover their own world of opportunities and possibilities. This happens by engaging a child in the context of their family issues. We know that, to end a cycle of abuse or trauma, we must work with children to clarify their thoughts and feelings and get a realistic view of each family member’s role in their life.

In response to this community-wide challenge, Presbyterian Children’s Homes and Services (PCHAS), now operates 12 programs in 34 locations, serving nearly 4,500 children and families each year, which provide children with permanent homes and adults with increased self-sufficiency. This is accomplished by the agency’s commitment to “The PCHAS Way” which inspires the agency to be strength-focused, family-centered, and goal driven with every client.

Benefits of serving children and families in need through PCHAS include competitive salaries, flex work schedules, paid time off, medical, dental and vision insurance options, voluntary life insurance options, paid holidays, and a very generous retirement plan (after one year of service and working 1,000 hours the agency matches an employee 200% up to a 3%.

As a secondary responsibility, this position serves as a technical escalation and backup resource for the external client support and Information Systems Support teams during periods of limited staff availability.

Essential Job Functions

Develop, maintain, and enhance CSWIS forms, workflows, application features, and user-facing functionality.
Design and implement interactive dashboards, analytics tools, and reporting solutions that support operational and strategic decision-making.
Collaborate with stakeholders to define business requirements and translate organizational needs into technical solutions.
Develop and optimize SQL queries, views, stored procedures, and datasets that support reporting and application functionality.
Design and maintain responsive user interfaces and layouts that improve usability across device types.
Serve as a Tier 3 escalation and backup resource for the external client support and Information Systems Support teams, assisting with application troubleshooting and urgent client or agency requests as needed.
Other duties as assigned.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Software Development, related field, or equivalent experience.
Minimum of five years of experience developing and supporting database-driven web applications.
Minimum of three years of experience designing reports, dashboards, or business intelligence solutions.

Knowledge / Skills / Abilities

Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
Strong understanding of reporting methodologies and KPI development.
Excellent organizational and project management skills, including the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
Ability to remain current with evolving web development, reporting, and data analytics technologies.

Technical Skills

ASP.NET (C#)
SQL Server / T-SQL
HTML
CSS
JavaScript
MS Access
Responsive Web Design
Data Modeling
Business Intelligence Reporting

Working Conditions

Typical office setting, work at desk 95% of the time, equipment to be used includes computer, teleconferencing equipment, and a phone.

Other Requirements

Must hold a valid driver’s license, have and maintain a risk-free driving record. Must be willing to undergo initial and periodic child abuse/neglect, criminal history, sexual offender, and child care/elder care disqualification list screenings . As requested, must submit fingerprints for review by the state of your employment and Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI). Must undergo a pre-employment drug screen and a pre-employment physical with the results showing no evidence of communicable disease.

Christian Commitment

Presbyterian Children’s Homes and Services (PCHAS) is a faith-based organization guided by Christ’s love, dedicated to creating a world where every child is safe, every family is strong, and hope outshines hardship.

Through Christ-centered care, we empower children, young adults, and families by nurturing their strengths, resilience, and faith. We strive to serve like Jesus—meeting those we serve where they are, treating them with dignity and compassion, and walking alongside them with grace and understanding.

At PCHAS, we focus on the strengths and potential within each individual, encouraging those we serve to look forward with hope and confidence rather than being defined by past challenges. When we live out this mission well, we help children and families experience hope, thrive in their journeys, and know the enduring love of God.
